title: Exploiting Feature-invariant Scaling Laws for Efficient A/B Experimentation in Recommendation Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.13539v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Researchers and engineers improve recommendation systems by performing A/B experiments with new model architectures, optimization methods, and data features. However, running full-scale experiments (e.g., full-model training with online data) for every feature change is prohibitively computationally intensive, while the result from a single small-scale experiment is often misleading. To address this challenge, we show that modern recommendation models exhibit feature-invariant scaling: the change of a model's performance follows a predictable scaling-law even when different feature changes are applied to the baseline model. We introduce an efficient method that exploits scaling-laws and uses statistical inference to predict (with confidence intervals) the full-scale effect of an A/B experiment in recommendation systems. translated_title: 利用特征不变的缩放定律实现推荐系统中高效的A/B实验
translated_abstract: 研究人员和工程师通过进行A/B实验来改进推荐系统，实验内容涉及新的模型架构、优化方法和数据特征。然而，针对每一次特征变更都运行全规模实验（例如使用在线数据进行全模型训练）的计算成本过高，而单个小规模实验的结果往往具有误导性。为了应对这一挑战，我们证明了现代推荐模型表现出特征不变的缩放特性：即使对基线模型应用不同的特征变更，模型性能的变化仍遵循可预测的缩放定律。我们提出了一种高效方法，利用缩放定律并结合统计推断来预测（并提供置信区间）推荐系统中A/B实验在全规模下的效果。这使得从业者能够仅通过小规模实验就高效地过滤掉中性或造成性能退化的特征变更。
tldr: 该论文发现现代推荐模型具有特征不变的缩放定律特性，并提出一种结合统计推断的方法，能仅通过小规模A/B实验预测全规模实验效果（含置信区间），从而大幅降低特征变更评估的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that modern recommendation models exhibit feature-invariant scaling laws, and proposes an efficient method combining statistical inference to predict full-scale A/B experiment effects (with confidence intervals) from small-scale experiments, greatly reducing the computational cost of evaluating feature changes.
